caption: The video captures the interior of a clear blender jar filmed from the side, with a metal blade assembly at the bottom center and a molded handle on the left wall. The bright back panel carries horizontal measurement marks and scattered colored splatters that remain in place. The bottom blades change orientation over time, showing rotation. A green candy, later showing a pale 'S' on its surface, and yellow pieces hang in the air on the right, tumbling so bright faces alternate with pale ones. The green object stays near the top edge for much of the time, then moves downward along the right side. The yellow pieces rise, and one drifts leftward, closing in on the green object before the two part again. A few small flying fragments shift against the fixed splatters near the left wall. The process is already in motion at the start and continues without any resolution shown.
relations: The bottom blades rotate, changing orientation over time.
A green candy and yellow pieces tumble, shifting positions relative to each other.
Small flying fragments move against the stationary splatters on the back panel.
The yellow pieces drift leftward toward the green object before separating.
